import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX = 250010;
    static int n, k, p;
    static int[] b = new int[MAX];
    static long[][] x = new long[26][MAX];
    static long[] fact = new long[MAX];
    static long[] invFact = new long[MAX];
    static long base, result;
    static final int BUFSIZE = (1 << 19) + 1;
    static char[] buf = new char[BUFSIZE];
    static int bufPos = 0, bufSize = 0;

    static long qpow(long baseVal, int y) {
        long res = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) res = res * baseVal % p;
            baseVal = baseVal * baseVal % p;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int gc(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        if (bufPos == bufSize) {
            bufSize = br.read(buf, 0, BUFSIZE);
            bufPos = 0;
            if (bufSize == -1) return -1;
        }
        return buf[bufPos++];
    }

    static void getInt(BufferedReader br, int[] x) throws IOException {
        int flag = 1;
        int c;
        c = gc(br);
        while (c != -1 && (c < '0' || c > '9')) {
            if (c == '-') flag = -1;
            c = gc(br);
        }
        int res = 0;
        while (c != -1 && c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = gc(br);
        }
        x[0] = res * flag;
    }

    static long calc(int depth, int num) {
        if (b[num] < depth) return 0;
        if (depth == 1) return x[depth][num];
        if (x[depth][num] != 0) return x[depth][num];
        int cnt = 0;
        int m = num;
        while (m != 0) {
            m &= (m - 1);
            if (b[m] >= depth - 1) {
                x[depth][num] += calc(depth - 1, m) * x[num ^ m][num];
                if (++cnt == 18) {
                    cnt = 0;
                    x[depth][num] %= p;
                }
            }
        }
        x[depth][num] %= p;
        return x[depth][num];
    }

    static long choose(int n, int m) {
        return fact[n] * invFact[m] % p * invFact[n - m] % p;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int[] temp = new int[1];

        getInt(br, temp);
        n = temp[0];
        getInt(br, temp);
        k = temp[0];
        getInt(br, temp);
        p = temp[0];

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            b[i] = b[i >> 1] + (i & 1);
        }

        base = qpow(k, n);

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println((int) base);
            return;
        }

        int lim = Math.min(k, b[n]);
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % p;
        }
        invFact[n] = qpow(fact[n], p - 2);
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
            invFact[i] = invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p;
        }

        result = 0;
        for (int i = lim; i >= 1; i--) {
            result += choose(k, i) * calc(i, n);
        }
        result %= p;
        base = (base - result * fact[n] % p + p) % p;
        System.out.println(base);
    }
}
